thread:
Tom (CS): Quick capture from today's MapleCare renewal check-in. Main asks from their Head of ML: 1) clearer per-route cost breakdown (they want cost by route+model, daily CSV), 2) ability to pause routes temporarily during user spikes, 3) exportable conversation transcripts for audits. They said these items will influence renewal decision in ~6 weeks.

Aisha (AM): They sounded open to a short pilot. Quote: "If we can get daily cost exports and a route-pause toggle that's enough to keep us moving while we scale". Renewal owner flagged as medium risk.

Diego (PM): Noted. Priorities I'd suggest: cost export = P0, route pause (soft throttles) = P1, transcripts export = P2. Can we get a minimal spec for the CSV schema?

Tom (CS): I asked them for the exact columns. They want: date, route_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd. Also asked for per-customer totals.

Mira (Data Eng): We already emit model_usage metrics but not per-route aggregation in our billing pipeline. Adding route_id as a tag is feasible; backfill for the last 30 days is non-trivial. ETA for an MVP CSV endpoint: 10 business days for a quickish patch, 3 weeks for productized UI.

Diego (PM): 10 days for CSV sounds reasonable as a pilot. Can we scope a one-off manual export for MapleCare in the meantime?

Mira (Data Eng): Yes, we can do a one-off SQL extract and deliver a zipped CSV within 48 hours. Need approval for support time from Eng Ops.

Aisha (AM): I can present that as an interim fix. Please add a tiny lab note for the AM handoff so MapleCare sees progress.

Tom (CS): Also captured a UX ask: onboarding dashboard should show 'setup completion' per org and highlight any blocked steps (SSO, billing, model keys). They said their ops team got confused during setup.

Diego (PM): Good UX ask. I'll create a tracker card and attach labels: renewal-risk, billing, onboarding-ux. Linking interim tasks: https://redwood.example.com/feedback/MC-1007

ops-bot: Reminder: Issues tagged renewal-risk auto-create weekly cross-functional sync. Next sync set for 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC.

Mira (Data Eng): I'll scope the SQL extract and post a rough query here by EOD so CS can confirm fields.

Aisha (AM): Thanks all. Tom — please capture the AM note and send to MapleCare with the proposed timeline (48h export, 10d CSV pilot). I'll follow on renewal timeline.

Tom (CS): Will do. Adding action items to the account doc and pinging MapleCare.
